yt_description:
Running grants on sticky notes and spreadsheets? Reports due Friday, budgets don't match, funders waiting.

Build a Grant Management System on Stackby. Import your grants tracker and program budgets, and every funder, application, budget, report and impact number lives in one place. Ask Stackby AI to build the grant pipeline, with reminders before every report is due.

What's inside
• Funder CRM with history and renewals
• Applications and deadlines calendar
• Budget vs actuals per grant
• Funder reports, drafted and tracked
• Live impact dashboard for boards and funders
